beforeImage.name: Odfjell Terminals US
beforeImage.description: Odfjell Terminals US owns and operates bulk liquid storage terminals that handle chemicals, oil products, and other specialty liquids at major shipping locations. Its customers are industrial and trading counterparties that require marine-connected storage and handling infrastructure rather than inland distribution assets. The business follows an asset-heavy contracted terminal model built around tanks, marine access, and associated operating infrastructure at strategic ports. Public materials describe U.S. terminals in Houston, Texas, and Charleston, South Carolina as part of Odfjell's global terminal network. Funds managed by Northleaf acquired a 49% shareholding in June 2019, with Odfjell SE retaining 51% and continuing as the industrial partner.

afterImage.name: Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC
afterImage.description: Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC is the joint-venture parent of Odfjell's marine-connected bulk-liquid storage terminals in Houston, Texas and North Charleston, South Carolina. The platform provides tank storage and multimodal handling for chemicals, petrochemicals, oil products, biofuels, edible oils and gases through marine, barge, rail, truck and pipeline infrastructure. Northleaf acquired a 49% interest from Lindsay Goldberg on June 7, 2019 through NCP US Terminals LP; Odfjell SE retains 51% through Odfjell Terminals Americas LLC and remains the operating partner. The August 6, 2026 Delaware Chancery judgment resolved the shareholder dispute without changing ownership.
